atlas.note: Slots past the last master tile are index 0 padding.

collision.fields: tiles[].feature_type (terra byte 1 high nibble) and tiles[].subtile_mask (terra byte 2)
collision.rule: px_to_im(x, y) returns feature_type when subtile_mask has bit 0x80 >> (4*col + row) set for sub-tile col = (x>>3)&1, row = (y>>3)&3 (8x8 px), else 0. prox blocks movement on 1 and on >= 10; proxcheck lets the hero through 8 and 9; 12 passes with the Shard; 15 is an openable door (doorfind). Named types: 1 impassable, 2 sink, 3 slow/brush; 13 is furniture (beds), 15 doors.

dedup.rule: Identical palette-index tiles collapse into one master tile. The key also holds the region's colour-31 value (when the tile uses index 31), the tile's shadow mask entry and occlusion mode, and its collision record (feature_type, subtile_mask), so every master tile is a complete stand-in for an original tile id: atlas_rgba.png, atlas_shadowmask.png and the walkability are exact 1:1 lookups. Art that appears with different masks/modes/collision is kept once per combination.

index_31.note: Master tiles containing palette index 31, the only colour fade_page changes per region; each carries its color_31.
index_31.secret_variants_note: While secret_timer runs (Crystal Orb, magic case 8 fmain.c:3307; decremented fmain.c:1381) region 9 shows colour 31 as 0x00f0, revealing hidden passages. Each affected tile has a second master tile (variant): identical indices, colour 31 = 0x00f0 in atlas_rgba.png. Draw the variant while the timer runs, or swap palette entry 31 when using atlas_indexed.png.

palette.index_31: verbatim source indices; opaque (no key colour). atlas_rgba.png draws each tile's index-31 pixels in its color_31 (palettes/region_overrides.json).

region_maps_note: region_maps[R][t] is the master tile index for region R's tile t, or null when no sector referenced by region R's map contains tile t.

shadow_mask.note: The 16x32 shadow mask (assets/masks/ entry tiles[].mask, from terra byte 0) the game applies over sprites behind the tile, or empty when tiles[].mask_mode (terra byte 1 & 15) is 0. The mode decides when it is applied (fmain.c:2584-2594); see region tiles.json.shadow_mask.

usage.rule: A tile is used by a region when it appears in a shipped map (assets/maps) drawn with that region's tileset: the overworld for regions 0-7 (tile = sector_mem[map_mem[sec_num]*128 + row*16 + col]); for regions 8 and 9, which share one map and sector pool, the interior spaces the game enters with that region loaded (door secs, stargate, quicksand drop). Parts of the interior map no entry reaches count for neither.
